question: Does rotating every free message word produce a rotated digest under the actual constants?
number: Existing exact local run: for every k=1..31 over 2^18 random m8..m15 samples, maximum rotated-equal digest words was 0; minimum digest Hamming distance was 87 bits; initial-state rotation distance was nonzero for every k. Symmetric all-zero-state control behaves as expected.
source: our workflow: D658 audit of the existing BLAKE3-r3 rotational test
held_fixed: actual BLAKE3-r3 constants, free m8..m15 family, recorded 2^18 random samples per k
notes: Finite sampled negative control only; it does not prove universal absence of rotational structure and gives no score/package credit.
reopen_if: A universal rotational relation or a reproducible excess beyond the sampled control is proposed
